description: This file contains implementation code for initializing indirection buffers used in various 3D convolution, deconvolution, and max pooling operations in a quantized neural network context. It includes functions for setting up pointers to input data for convolution operations with detailed handling of padding, strides, dilation, and kernel sizes.

methods.name: void pytorch_qnnp_indirection_init_conv3d(pytorch_qnnp_operator_t op,size_t output_tile_size,size_t tiled_output_size)
methods.description: Initializes the indirection buffer for 3D convolution, setting pointers to input data based on kernel parameters, padding, and stride for each spatial position.

methods.name: void pytorch_qnnp_indirection_init_dwconv(pytorch_qnnp_operator_t op,size_t batch_start)
methods.description: Initializes the indirection buffer for depthwise 3D convolution, computing correct pointer positions to input data considering dilation, stride, and padding.

methods.name: void pytorch_qnnp_indirection_init_deconv2d(pytorch_qnnp_operator_t op,size_t output_tile_size,size_t tiled_output_size)
methods.description: Sets up the indirection buffer for 2D deconvolution, handling spatial position calculations and pointer assignments.

methods.name: void pytorch_qnnp_indirection_init_maxpool2d(pytorch_qnnp_operator_t op,size_t batch_start)
methods.description: Creates the indirection buffer for 2D max pooling by pointing to input elements within pooling windows, considering padding and stride.

methods.name: void pytorch_qnnp_indirection_set_step_dimensions(pytorch_qnnp_operator_t op)
methods.description: Precomputes and sets step dimensions (depth, height, width) in the operator based on kernel size, dilation, and stride, to facilitate efficient indirection buffer setup.
